text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just eating the right foods, though a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains is a solid start. Regular exercise, even thirty minutes of walking each day, boosts energy and strengthens the heart. Equally important is getting enough sleep—aim for seven to eight hours a night to let your body recover. But don’t forget mental health; practice stress management through hobbies or quiet time. Finally, strive for a reasonable work-life balance by setting boundaries between your job and personal time. Small, daily choices in these four areas build a stronger, happier you.
